Anna Maria and Brian Clement interview holistic biometric dentist Dr. Paul O'Malley about why dentistry is often overlooked despite its deep links to overall health. They discuss research connecting periodontal infection to strokes, cardiovascular disease and cancer, the high prevalence of gum infection by age 50, and the rise of biomimetic, minimally invasive dental techniques.

The episode covers practical advice on prevention and care — from water picks, brushing, flossing and night guards for grinding and sleep apnea, to debates around root canals versus implants, fluoride arresting cavities, ozone, regenerative research, and supportive nutrition and supplements. Resources and educational courses from Dr. O'Malley are also mentioned for listeners seeking holistic dental care.
